text:
anu: Noticed a 10h gap in hourly_count for ap-southeast, looks like late events queued during a k8s drain.
marco: Can we avoid full re-ingest? compute-only recompute might fix aggregates.
anu: Agree. But console quota for admin-agg is low today.
judy: Suggest micro-chunks: 15m compute-only slices, concurrency=1, priority=low.
marco: Also add auto-pause: if post-recompute diff > 2% for two consecutive slices, stop.
judy: I'll prepare curl for admin endpoint.
anu: please include trace_id so we can correlate with ingress logs.
replay-bot: automated: admin-agg tokens=4. Recommend max_concurrent=1.
marco: OK starting dry-run 15m slice now. Will post sample diffs.
anu: thanks, and add a short console note (ops-only) so next time folks don't trigger a big rehydrate by accident.
